NEW YORK CITY COUNCIL STATED MEETING 79 Our city budget must reflect our moral values and meet the current political moment. Right now, our city is under attack from an authoritarian administration hellbent on destroying the civil liberties we hold dear. And this budget shows that New York will not stand idly by, but will fight back using every tool in our arsenal. While the president, Supreme Court, and Republican extremists tell queer and trans youth they don’t matter, we secure $8.5 million for gender affirming care and LGBTQIA+ youth support services. As our immigrant communities are targeted and citizenship questioned, we are investing nearly $75 million to defend immigrant New Yorkers. And as the Trump administration slashes all sorts of public assistance, we are investing hundreds of millions to stabilize 3K and Pre-K, pilot universal childcare for kids age two and under, fund emerging food programs, and provide direct cash assistance to some of our vulnerability New Yorkers — not to mention the tens of millions of dollars for cultural institutions and libraries, which are some of our most democratic institutions.
